literature_basis: ReAct evaluates ALFWorld with a competent prompted agent and reports 70.9/78.4 percent success using one or two in-context examples.
Reflexion official ALFWorld run uses 134 environments per trial and 10 iterative trials.
ALFWorld and Reflexion configs use a 50-step episode cap.
AutoManual uses 6 environments per task in its building stage and 25 per task in testing.
ExpeL ALFWorld insight extraction uses 8 experiences per iteration and 2-fold evaluation.
